title: Ma Gomba Third Meeting

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Well, somebody just can't stay away. Tell me, how do my mushrooms grow?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, somebody just can't stay away. Tell me, how do my mushrooms grow?

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: “Do I have any more”. How funny you are. Of course I do. Shiitake, oyster, snow funghi, you name it. Unless you’d like something a little more… adventurous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: “Do I have any more”. How funny you are. Of course I do. Shiitake, oyster, snow funghi, you name it. Unless you’d like something a little more… adventurous.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Willing to take risks, to try new experiences and sensations. If you are, I have just the thing to set you apart from your competitors. A tasty little ectomycorrhizal morel. Mouth-watering when stir fried with pork.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Willing to take risks, to try new experiences and sensations. If you are, I have just the thing to set you apart from your competitors. A tasty little ectomycorrhizal morel. Mouth-watering when stir fried with pork.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: It simply means mutually beneficial. We all get what we want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It simply means mutually beneficial. We all get what we want.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: You want to escape the substrate of this sorry place. Just like your old mentor tried to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want to escape the substrate of this sorry place. Just like your old mentor tried to.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: You know the glorious thing about mushrooms? They’re quite impossible to kill. Cut them down and you only spread them further. Thaddeus should have remembered that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know the glorious thing about mushrooms? They’re quite impossible to kill. Cut them down and you only spread them further. Thaddeus should have remembered that.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: No, you don’t. But you might one day. Especially if you take what I offer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, you don’t. But you might one day. Especially if you take what I offer.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: What a shame. I do hope your business doesn't rot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What a shame. I do hope your business doesn't rot.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Wonderful. You’ll be spawning Lims in no time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wonderful. You’ll be spawning Lims in no time.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: As you wish. I do hope your business doesn't wither.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As you wish. I do hope your business doesn't wither.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: To truly nurture them you will need a top quality module. Grade A at least. And of course, mushrooms require special conditions. High humidity and low light. Can you remember that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To truly nurture them you will need a top quality module. Grade A at least. And of course, mushrooms require special conditions. High humidity and low light. Can you remember that?

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: How dull for you. I suppose you've been talking to that turnip-lover, Hortelano?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How dull for you. I suppose you've been talking to that turnip-lover, Hortelano?

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Oh, honestly. That was a simply a new strain of pathogenic fungus. So what if a few carrots deliquesced?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, honestly. That was a simply a new strain of pathogenic fungus. So what if a few carrots deliquesced?

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Wonderful. And just in time. I have some new spores which are rather... adventurous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wonderful. And just in time. I have some new spores which are rather... adventurous.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Not literally, but figuratively.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not literally, but figuratively.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: I believe you my little Champignon. Are you ready to grow these morels? If you do, I will have a special offer for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe you my little Champignon. Are you ready to grow these morels? If you do, I will have a special offer for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Very well. Do you have any more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very well. Do you have any more?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Very well. Do you have any more?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Very well. Do you have any more?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Define adventurous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Define adventurous.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel hungry already.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel hungry already.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does “ectomycorrhizal” mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does “ectomycorrhizal” mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And what do I want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what do I want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean “tried”? Is Thaddeus still here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean “tried”? Is Thaddeus still here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you mean “tried”? Is Thaddeus still here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you mean “tried”? Is Thaddeus still here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don’t get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, but no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, but no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, I’m game.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, I’m game.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll stick with what I know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll stick with what I know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll stick with what I know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll stick with what I know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have any tips for growing better mushrooms?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have any tips for growing better mushrooms?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you have any tips for growing better mushrooms?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you have any tips for growing better mushrooms?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm going to focus on vegetables for now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going to focus on vegetables for now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm going to focus on vegetables for now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm going to focus on vegetables for now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I heard a rumor that your mushrooms caused last year's carrot shortage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I heard a rumor that your mushrooms caused last year's carrot shortage.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I heard a rumor that your mushrooms caused last year's carrot shortage.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I heard a rumor that your mushrooms caused last year's carrot shortage.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I just love radishes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I just love radishes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your Enoki are beautiful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your Enoki are beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah. No. It doesn't mean that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. No. It doesn't mean that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah. No. It doesn't mean that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah. No. It doesn't mean that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt.
